title: Honeypots and honeytokens: detection by bait

videos.script: Every detector in this course has the same problem. Almost everything it sees is normal. {{bait}} Bait turns that around. A machine nobody uses. A file nobody opens. An account that exists nowhere. {{touch}} Nobody's work touches them, so any touch is a finding. {{honeypot}} In this lesson you put a small honeypot on the lab's spare machine, and touch it from the workstation. One line says which machine came. {{token}} Then a file of fake credentials on the portal, watched by the kernel, and a username that exists only in that file. {{place}} And the rules that keep bait useful: where it goes, where it never goes, and who reads the alert.
